name: Mwanza Jazz Festival
description: The biggest jazz festival in the Lake Zone! Three days of live performances featuring local and international artists, food stalls, and art exhibitions at the Kamanga Waterfront.

name: Lake Victoria Marathon
description: Annual marathon along the scenic shores of Lake Victoria. Categories include full marathon, half marathon, and 10km fun run. All proceeds support community health initiatives in the region.

name: Sukuma Heritage Day
description: A vibrant celebration of Sukuma culture featuring traditional dances, drumming workshops, storytelling sessions, craft markets, and authentic Sukuma cuisine. Open to all visitors.

name: Mwanza Food Festival
description: Taste the best of Mwanza! Local restaurants and street food vendors come together for a weekend of culinary delights. Highlights include a nyama choma cook-off and lakeside BBQ competition.

name: Saanane Island Cleanup & Nature Walk
description: Join fellow nature lovers for a community cleanup of Saanane Island followed by a guided nature walk with park rangers. Learn about conservation efforts and the unique wildlife of Tanzania's smallest national park.
